audio_role: Loud funky dance-pop track with female vocals plays throughout, no voiceover, no sizzle or ASMR. The lens-wipe at 3.9s lands on a beat drop, then the 0.7-0.9s food cuts land on successive beats, driving the fast slideshow feel.
can_make: We can make all of it without a shoot. Shot 1: empty wood table photo, add blur-to-black in edit to fake hand over lens. Shot 2: composite wide spread from real menu photos of nachos, pasta, chicken, wraps plus sodas on same table background. Shots 3-7: tight crops of real menu photos, each held 0.7-1.5s with a tiny digital push-in, no one touches or eats. House cast not needed because no one appears. 4s AI clips not needed except to add faint steam/shine if wanted. Recreate white text and hard cuts on beat in edit.
core: A fake dirty camera is wiped to reveal the same empty table suddenly full of sharp, colorful food.
dish: Cafe mixed spread on one round table: cheesy chicken nachos with jalapenos and olives, creamy mushroom penne with basil and cherry tomato, grilled chicken strips with white sauce, two paper-wrapped rolls with dips, two iced colas.
fits: Mixed sharing spreads and colorful saucy dishes with visible texture: loaded nachos/fries, creamy pasta, grilled strips, wraps, any set of 3-4 dishes that look different from each other in one wide shot.
hook: 0-1s: empty wood table in dark restaurant with white text 'Wait.. let me wipe the camera' as image goes soft and dark like a finger covering the lens.
people: nobody. No hands, faces or staff visible; only an unseen finger blurs the lens for the wipe effect.

shots.action: empty table sits, then lens is covered and goes to dark blur
full spread of nachos, pasta, chicken, wraps and colas sits revealed on the table
creamy mushroom penne with basil, tomato and grated cheese sits
cheesy nachos with jalapenos, olives and dip sits in foreground
sliced grilled chicken with white sauce drizzle, tomatoes and olives sits
two paper-wrapped rolls with ketchup and mayo dips sit on wooden board
melted cheese, chicken, jalapenos and olives on nachos sit in top-down macro

text_on_screen: 'Wait.. let me wipe the camera' over empty/blurred table, then 'ah, much better.' over all food shots, plus small STAR CAFE logo bottom-center throughout.
why_it_works: The blur to sharp contrast makes colors look more saturated, then it holds on melted cheese, creamy sauce and fresh herbs in big close-ups with no people or story to distract, so the viewer just scans textures and portion size.
